Establishes body proportions and base skin/fur/bone value only: a gaunt, rotting humanoid with mottled green-brown flesh and a sunken, fanged face; this decayed flesh is its native identity, not a costume or wound effect. prompt_fields.subject: One gaunt, undead ghoul, humanoid in build but visibly rotting: mottled green-brown patchy flesh, a sunken face with a wide fanged mouth and hollow eyes, standing in a calm neutral pose, weight even on both feet, arms relaxed at its sides with open clawed hands. Wears simple ragged but plain traveller clothing (a torn tunic or wrap, no armour, no class item) hanging loosely on its gaunt frame.
prompt_fields.contrast: Must occupy a clearly separate value/hue band from both skeleton and runic golem in this same package, none of the three collapsing into a generic dark humanoid blob against the charcoal-brown disc: (1) value — a mid-dark, uneven mottled value pattern (patchy rot, not a flat silhouette), distinctly darker overall than the skeleton's pale bone; (2) hue — a sickly green-brown hue running through the flesh, absent from the skeleton's neutral bone-grey and the golem's neutral stone-grey. Gaunt, sunken humanoid anatomy (not a bare bone frame, not a blocky carved stone body) is itself a silhouette cue.
prompt_fields.composition: One entire figure on one disc, steep overhead three-quarter view, facing down-left or down-right. Head, hands and feet stay well inside the disc with a clear margin; the outer sixth of the disc radius stays bare base plate. Keep the head out of the upper-right rank corner and the upper-left interaction corner. No second figure, no mount, no companion, no ground clutter.
prompt_fields.palette: Mottled sickly green-brown and grey-green rotting flesh, darker patches at joints and sunken face, yellowed teeth/claws, a plain ragged earth-toned wrap or tunic (dirty grey-brown). No blood spatter, no glow, no visible bone protruding through flesh (that belongs to the skeleton family).
